title: Collect skill documents and evaluations in an R package
text: Many AI skill repositories code snippet libraries, providing AI advanced copy-paste templates execute single task. fast, Code-Centric approach brittle, lacks autonomy, misses “” behind code. skills instead provide Workflow/Process Orchestration. treat AI like junior developer given Standard Operating Procedure (SOP). Rather just providing raw syntax, skill defines intent, multi-step workflow, domain knowledge required. example, code coverage skill doesn’t just provide command run covr; orchestrates workflow: run coverage, summarize gaps, classify testing needs (Normal Use, Edge Cases, Error Handling, Correctness), proactively write new test cases based criteria. approach enables high autonomy, encourages AI follow intent process orchestration, allows adapt different project structures using general reasoning capabilities.
